name: Anchor every intent to the prose
description: Each intent stores its quote with start and end offsets into the prose (the intent map). The quote is searched verbatim first, then ignoring case and runs of whitespace from a word boundary. If any quote is not found, or a beyond-proof intent has no reason, or a reason is unknown, or a decision has fewer than two options, a recommended index out of range or an unknown intent, the whole extraction is rejected with an ArtifactError listing every problem.
